references.text: Kiriath-jearim is also mentioned in the description of Judah's borders, which share a boundary line with Benjamin.
Kiriath-jearim is listed as one of the cities of Judah, showing the geographical connection between the tribes.
The previous verse in the same border description mentions Kiriath-baal, which is the same as Kiriath-jearim.
The spring of Me-neftoah is mentioned in the description of Judah's northern border, the same geographical reference point.
Kiriath-jearim was the place where the ark of the covenant was kept for twenty years after it returned from the Philistines.
David brought the ark of the covenant from Kiriath-jearim, showing the city's significance in Israel's history.
